- **Harness:** `devin-acp/devin/manual` (self-reported — BM-HARNESS-01)
- **Ticket:** `docs/tickets/093_S6.1b__assumption-debt-manager.md`
- **Branch:** `svitali/harnessharness-s6.1b` (stacked on
  `svitali/harnessharness-s6.1a` @ 5c95816 — the S6.1a chain tip)
- **Requirement:** R-2.9.6
- **Closes:** DF-S5.4-1 (the ledgered probation trigger surface);

## Gap analysis (existing seams vs ticket scope)

GATE-G3 carried five Stage-6-scoped OPEN rows forward; S6.1b is the
named owner of DF-S5.4-1 (ledgered probation) and of the DF-S1.24-1
debt-manager residual. The ontology already carried every record —
`DebtStatus`/`DebtClass`/`DeficiencyClass`, `RemovalTest` +
`RemovalVerdict`, `DebtPolicy` (cadence, `max_open_removal_tests`,
`expiry_urgency` classes, instrument-budget reservation),
`DebtHome`/`DEBT_HOMES`/`required_fields`, `RetirementRecord` — and
`hh-lab::debt` already folded `evaluate_debt` + `DebtObservables`
(warn/expire transitions, `DebtIndexRow`/`DebtReport`). What did not
exist: the manager service itself — the scheduler, the batch design
generator, the reflexive kind, the probation book, the retirement
gate, and the boundary surface.

| AC/leg | Landed | Where |
|---|---|---|
| `schedule_removal_test` under `DebtPolicy` | `hh_debt::schedule::schedule_removal_test` — enforced required-fields (`DebtHome`-keyed) at admission, `executable_kind` + `instantiates()` checks, cadence/`expiry_urgency` priority classes, `max_open_removal_tests` bound, instrument-budget reservation → `Deferred{reason}` never silent drop | `crates/hh-debt/src/schedule.rs` |
| Batch removal-test design generation | `schedule_batch` — removal-arm `ExperimentSpec` designs (`kind: retirement_batch`), rule linkage through `ext`, one design per debt ref, dedup by content-derived id | `crates/hh-debt/src/schedule.rs` · `s6_1b.rs` batch legs |
| Reflexive `no_dead_weight_found` | `RemovalTestKind::NoDeadWeightFound` + `DeadWeightWindow{model_version_changes}` (ontology, canonical codec, `instantiates()` requires `window`); `hh_debt::reflexive::{reflexive_record,evaluate_reflexive}` — the manager's own conditioned assumptions must produce a pass verdict inside the window or the debt stays live | `crates/hh-ontology/src/debt.rs` · `crates/hh-debt/src/reflexive.rs` |
| Retirement gate | `DebtManager::retire` requires a **pass** `RemovalVerdict` **and** a human-sealed `RetirementRecord`; refusal paths typed, retirement never deletes the debt row automatically | `crates/hh-debt/src/manager.rs` · `s6_1b.rs` retire legs |
| Durable state | `ManagerView` — a pure fold of the run's durable prefix (`lifecycle.debt.*` rows); `DebtManager::open` rebuilds by replay; no second authoritative store | `crates/hh-debt/src/view.rs` |
| Ledgered probation (DF-S5.4-1) | `sweep` mints `lifecycle.debt.probation.opened{debt_ref, opened_at_ms, due_at_ms}` for `hypothesized` records without a book entry; `ManagerView::ledgered_probation` projects `LedgeredProbation`; `evaluate_debt`'s probation leg fires `probation_overrun` on `due_at ≤ now` citing the ledgered `evt-*` as `evidence_ref` — book-of-record wins, foreign `debt_ref` falls through to the record-derived bound | `crates/hh-debt/src/manager.rs` · `crates/hh-lab/src/debt.rs` · `hh-lab/tests/s5_4.rs::ledgered_probation_overrun_cites_the_ledgered_row` |
| Ledger classes | `lifecycle.debt.{probation.opened, service.registered, sweep.completed}` registered (audit-grade, kernel-origin `commit_kernel_row_for`) | `crates/hh-ledger/src/classes.rs` |
| Removable C4 | `hh-debt` — new crate, zero upward edges, `hh-embed`'s `tier-c4` optional dep its only consumer; `--no-default-features` keeps the op schema and answers `Unsupported{by: "tier-c4"}` | `crates/hh-debt/` · `crates/hh-embed/Cargo.toml` · `scripts/check-removability.sh` S6.1b stanza |
| Boundary ops | `lab.debt.{manager_open,register,sweep,settle,retire,propose}` — experimental + `serves_measurement`, typed errors, schema-declared regardless of tier; strict record decode (malformed → typed refusal) | `crates/hh-embed-schema/src/ops.rs` · `crates/hh-embed/src/debt_manager_ops.rs` · `hh-embed/tests/s6_1b.rs` (6) |

## Decisions

See **ADR-0321** — manager-as-folded-service (D1), `DebtPolicy` as
the sole scheduling authority (D2), the ledgered probation book (D3),
the reflexive window verdict (D4), retirement = verdict + human seal
(D5), the C4 removable slice + `hh-embed` sole consumer (D6).

## In-run fixes worth recording

- **`hh-lab` probation leg — `Some(_)` shadowed the fallback.** A
  ledgered probation row for a *different* `debt_ref` suppressed
  evaluation of the record-derived bound entirely (test
  `left: 0 / right: 1`). Fixed: a mismatched-debt row now falls
  through to the record-derived bound; the ledgered row only
  overrides when it names the debt.
- **Ontology `ArmSpec`/`ExperimentSpec` shape assumptions.** First
  drafts assumed fields that don't exist (`to_json` on
  `SuiteBinding`/`ExperimentBudgets`, a dedicated removal-members
  field on `ExperimentSpec`). Corrected after reading
  `hh-lab/src/experiment.rs` — batch designs carry rule linkage
  through `ext`.
- **rustc 1.94.1 lint drift on landed S6.1a code.** `clippy
  --all-targets -D warnings` now flags three `hh-evolution` sites
  (`manual_contains` ×2 in `campaign.rs`, `explicit_auto_deref` in
  `errors.rs`) that were clean under the toolchain at commit
  `eda04f3`. Fixed mechanically (`stage.contains(&…)`,
  `=> stage`) — the diff is a lint-level change, no behavior.
- **Edit-tool write-loss anomaly recurred** on
  `crates/hh-evolution/src/{campaign,errors}.rs` — edits reported
  applied, absent on disk. Re-applied via python and verified by
  `grep`; the S5.6/S6.1a rule (verify by reading after every
  divergent edit) holds.
